mapper.select: select * from bed_info,elderly_info where bed_info.bed_id=elderly_info.bed_id and bed_info.bed_number!="";
select * from bed_info,elderly_info where bed_info.bed_id=elderly_info.bed_id and bed_info.bed_number!="" and bed_info.bed_number like "%"#{bedNumber}"%" and elderly_info.name like "%"#{name}"%"
select * from bed_info,elderly_info where bed_info.bed_id=elderly_info.bed_id and bed_info.bed_number!="" and elderly_info.name like "%"#{name}"%"
select * from bed_info,elderly_info where bed_info.bed_id=elderly_info.bed_id and bed_info.bed_number!="" and bed_info.bed_number like "%"#{bedNumber}"%"
select * from bed_info where floor_number=#{floorNumber} and room_number=#{roomNumber} and bed_number=#{bedNumber}
mapper.update: update bed_info,elderly_info set floor_number=#{floorNumber},room_number=#{newRoomNumber},bed_number=#{newBedNumber},check_in_time=Now() where bed_info.bed_id=elderly_info.bed_id and name=#{name}
mapper.select: SELECT bed_number, bed_status, room_number FROM bed_info WHERE floor = #{floor} ORDER BY room_number,bed_number
SELECT count( * ) AS count, bed_status FROM bed_info WHERE bed_status IN ( SELECT bed_status FROM bed_info WHERE floor = #{floor} ) AND floor = #{floor} GROUP BY bed_status ORDER BY bed_status
select distinct room_number from bed_info where floor_number = #{floorNumber} and bed_status = '1' # 该楼层有空的房间 and status = '1'
select distinct bed_number from bed_info where room_number = #{roomNumber} and bed_status = '1' # 该房间有空的床位
select distinct room_number from bed_info where floor_number = #{floorNumber} and bed_status != '1' # 该楼层已经使用的房间 and bed_status !='8' and status = '1'
select distinct bed_number from bed_info where room_number = #{roomNumber} and bed_status != '1' # 该楼层已经使用的房间 and bed_status != '8' and status = '1'

select * from bed_info,elderly_info where bed_info.bed_id=elderly_info.bed_id
and name like "%"#{name}"%"
and bed_number like "%"#{bedNumber}"%"
limit #{pageNum},#{pageSize}
